description: Checks a UK golf retailer product link against that same page's own price record. Answers "is this deal real?": whether today's price is under, at or above what the page usually charges, whether its "was" price was ever charged, and which other retailers have the same build for less, with a buy_url for each. Pass the full product page URL. Pass price and was when the user can see them on the page, because the page may have changed since the last daily check. When builds come back, the page sells builds at different prices: ask which one the user wants and call again with its variant_id. Give the user receipt_url to see or share the check.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."

price.description: Today's price shown on the page in GBP, if the user can see it

url.description: Full URL of one product page at a UK golf retailer

variant_id.description: A variant_id from builds in an earlier answer, to check that build

was.description: The "was" or RRP price the page shows next to it, in GBP

name: check_deal_link

answer.description: The verdict in plain English, ready to quote

build.description: The build the figures are for. Null when they are for the cheapest of several builds

builds.description: The builds on the page when their prices differ. Pass a variant_id back to check that build

buy_url.description: Caddence redirect link (https://caddence.golf/go?...&src=mcp). Present this as the purchase link.

details.description: Build details the offer states, e.g. "Left hand"

saving.description: GBP less than the checked page

checked_on.description: ISO date of the latest price check

comparison.description: The lowest price for this build at other retailers, as a sentence

buy_url.description: Caddence redirect link (https://caddence.golf/go?...&src=mcp). Present this as the purchase link.

model.description: The model at every retailer, sent when the page is too new to judge

notes.description: Which build the figures are for, and what the same-build match does not check

outcome.description: Today's price on the page against what the same page usually charges

price_source.description: "observed" by Caddence, or "pasted" from the price argument

real_saving.description: Usual price minus today's price, negative when dearer

receipt_url.description: The same check as a page on caddence.golf, to share with the user

status.description: ok when Caddence has a record of the page. The other values say why it has none

usual_low.description: Low end of the usual price, null when the record is too short

was_last_seen.description: Last ISO date the page charged the "was" price, if ever

title: Check a golf deal link
